reconciliation_notes: The page's own headline arithmetic (31 Original + 22 Licensed = 53) is CORRECT. An earlier automated single-fetch summary of this same page mis-classified 'Aestri Yazar & Baermar Uraz' (the paired duo from the Dungeons & Dragons chapter) as Licensed; they are actually Original characters that BHVR created 'inspired by' the D&D franchise, not existing D&D characters (this was verified directly on their character page, which explicitly states 'They are original characters inspired by the 1974 Board game Dungeons & Dragons'). Correcting that one row makes the hand-count match the page's stated 31/22 split exactly. The separate Category:Survivors page lists 54 pages; the extra one is 'Aurora', an UPCOMING/unreleased survivor (Chapter 41: Chorus of Sin, scheduled 25 Aug 2026, billed as the first Survivor designed by the community via 'The Grimoire' initiative alongside upcoming killer 'The Judgment') - confirmed via direct page fetch which states 'Aurora is an upcoming survivor'. She is excluded from the 53-entry list below since she is not yet in the game as of 2026-07-06.
